title: AssistantConversationResponse
description: Response body of GET /api/assistant-conversations/:id (HEL-663) and POST /api/assistant-conversations (create) -- the summary fields plus the full transcript. The transcript crosses the wire as opaque JSON (an array of ClaudeToolMessage-shaped objects, com.helio.infrastructure.ai) rather than a strictly-typed shape -- see AssistantConversationProtocol.scala's header comment for why. RLS-scoped to the owner; 404 for a missing or non-owned id. `hopBudgetExhausted`/`searchedWithNoResults` (HEL-667) are ephemeral signals describing the turn that just completed -- present only on a POST /:id/converse response, always absent on GET. HEL-1755: `model` is the stored selection and `effectiveModel` the resolved model for the next turn.

transcript.description: The full conversation transcript -- an array of ClaudeToolMessage-shaped turns: { role: string, content: [...] }.

model.description: HEL-1755: on an assistant turn, the model id that answered it (the API response's own model), stamped by the server. A client-supplied value on create/messages is discarded. Absent on user turns and on turns saved before HEL-1755.

hopBudgetExhausted.description: HEL-667: true when the just-completed converse turn hit the 3-hop tool-call cap before a final answer. Only present on a POST /:id/converse response; absent on GET.

searchedWithNoResults.description: HEL-667: true when the just-completed converse turn's last tool call was a zero-result find immediately followed by a final answer with no captured proposal. Only present on a POST /:id/converse response; absent on GET.

lastIdempotencyKey.description: HEL-698: the idempotency key of the most recent KEYED append -- unlike hopBudgetExhausted/searchedWithNoResults, this IS a persisted fact about the conversation, so it is populated on BOTH GET and converse responses. Absent until the first keyed append occurs.

model.description: HEL-1755: the conversation's stored model id; null/absent = none stored.

effectiveModel.description: HEL-1755: the server-resolved model the next turn will use (stored if still selectable, else the user's default if still selectable, else the server default).
